The best all-round pick under ₹20,000 is the Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G at ₹18,999 for its camera and screen. The three below are the popular ones from one buying guide.

Phone	Price	Battery	Camera	Screen
Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G	₹18,999	5100mAh, 67W	200MP with OIS	6.67" AMOLED, 120Hz
Realme Narzo 70 Pro 5G	₹18,499	5000mAh, 67W	50MP Sony with OIS	6.67" AMOLED, 120Hz
Poco X6 5G	₹17,999	5100mAh, 67W	64MP with OIS	6.67" AMOLED, 120Hz
Cheapest: Poco X6, but it comes with a lot of pre-installed apps.
Camera: Redmi has the highest megapixels. Realme is praised for its OIS.
Battery: The Samsung Galaxy M14 5G has the biggest at 6000mAh and costs ₹14,999 but its screen is LCD, not AMOLED.

Prices and specs come from a single guide updated Sun 25 Oct 2026, so check the final price in the shop before you buy. Want me to look up live prices for these three?

Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
7:19 AM

Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan with a rest break every afternoon, so your parents aren't rushed.

Day 1, Old city: Hawa Mahal in the morning, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Lunch, a rest, and an evening stroll through Johari Bazaar with dinner nearby.
Day 2, Forts: Amer Fort early, before the heat and crowds, with a jeep up the slope instead of the walk. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal, rest after lunch, then watch the sunset from Nahargarh Fort and have dinner there.
Day 3, Easy day and shopping: Albert Hall Museum, Birla Mandir, then Bapu Bazaar for block-print fabrics and jootis. Leave in the afternoon.

A cab with a driver for all three days saves a lot of walking. Winter is the best time to go, as Jaipur is pleasant from now until about March.

Do either of your parents find stairs or long walks hard? I can swap the forts for easier places.
